ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 10-15% coverage of high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels concentrated in specific anomalies and distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black contiguous field; large irregular diagonal white patch in the lower-central region of the right lobe; high-intensity clusters localized at the distal left and right tips; sparse linear white streaks and small circular spots distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse V-shaped depression at the central midline with a wide interior angle (~130 degrees).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring multiple small peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the central notch leading to an upward-tapering distal sweep at both lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular and semi-circular pixel groups at the distal tips; scattered smaller white circular points across the central black surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical white scratch on the left lobe; multiple fine, unaligned white linear marks on both lobes; a large diagonal multi-line scratch pattern on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified accretions (barnacles) at both distal lobe tips; large irregular white pigmentation patch on the right lobe; numerous linear rake marks across the surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The large diagonal white patch on the right lobe is the primary distinctive visual marker, containing internal black pixel striations.
